channel.title: Flipped Updates — Beta Channel
channel.description: Pre-release Flipped updates. Pete tests on his Mac before promoting to the public appcast.xml. Run `scripts/promote-release.sh` from the flipped-web-work repo to move a release from beta to stable.

item.title: Version 1.0.59
item.description:
Setup-stuck telemetry.

When iPhone enrollment fails and you reach the "Enrollment
didn't complete" card, Flipped now reports that to us in
the background so we can help you faster.

No UI change.  If your setup works on the first try, you
won't see anything different.

item.title: Version 1.0.58
item.description:
Simple is now fully locked.

Simple's apps can't be un-ticked anymore.  You can ADD apps
to your Simple block list, but the core social + streaming
+ App Store set is required — that's what Simple means.

If you want full control over what's blocked, create a new
custom profile instead.  Custom profiles can include or
exclude anything you want.

Two related bug fixes:

- The profile editor's un-tick now actually works on custom
  profiles.  Previously, server-side rules could re-add an
  app you'd just removed.  What the editor shows IS what
  hides on your iPhone.

- Existing Simple profiles get App Store added automatically
  on first launch (it became a required block in v1.0.57 but
  customized Simple profiles didn't pick up the change).

item.title: Version 1.0.57
item.description:
Simple now hides the App Store.

After a 15-minute check-in ends, the apps that come back
match exactly what you picked — no more stale picks from
old profiles dragging in extra blocks.

The 15-min check-in button hides itself after you use it
and resets at the start of your next session.

EMERGENCY UNFLIP hides itself after you use it OR while
you're in the 30-day cooldown.  Sessions longer than a
week route to support@useflipped.com instead.

Web parity: useflipped.com/flip now has its own EMERGENCY
UNFLIP and 15-min check-in buttons — same monthly
allowance, same per-session reset.

item.title: Version 1.0.56
item.description:
Onboarding polish — less crowded, one less click.

Pre-flight step is leaner.  The "why this is safe"
explainer is now a tap-to-expand card instead of
a wall of text, and the top intro is two sentences
instead of three.

Setup flow is one click shorter.  The "Profile
installed" success screen between Setting Up and
Finalizing is gone — your iPhone now goes straight
from the setup progress bar to the three taps that
finish enrollment.  Same announcement now lives in
Finalizing's title.

Settings → Danger Zone "Other actions" is actually
clickable now.  Before the chevron was invisible on
macOS and the section read as a static label.  Now
it's a proper tap-to-expand toggle.

Welcome screen rebalanced — wordmark smaller as a
brand stamp, "Flip your phone." bigger as the
visual hero, GET STARTED anchored to the bottom of
the window.

Plus: the removal-failed detail panel no longer
surfaces internal supervise paths — just the
actual error and how to fix it.

item.title: Version 1.0.55
item.description:
Two reliability fixes.

Edits to the Simple profile now actually apply when
you tap FLIP.  Pre-1.0.55, removing an app from
Simple (or any preset you'd edited) silently fell
back to the hardcoded preset list — so the app you
just unchecked got hidden anyway.  Now the edited
version wins, like you'd expect.

Same fix covers edits to Deep Work and Nomad.

Plus: the orange "waiting" badge during flip now
reads "WAITING FOR IPHONE · WAKE OR UNLOCK" — the
old "UNLOCK TO APPLY" copy lied any time iOS was
just briefly busy on an awake phone (network blip,
mid-update, etc.).  Cosmetic, but accurate matters.

Server-side (no Mac update needed): the website's
manual FLIP button now works regardless of which
profile mode you've selected — was silently 422-ing
on focus / unplug mode for months under a generic
"[object Object]" error.

item.title: Version 1.0.54
item.description:
Open-beta launch quality bundle.

Setup flow:
• "Setup failed" no longer surfaces on transient
  hiccups — the backend is now the source of truth
  on whether enrollment landed.
• "START FRESH SETUP" button appears after a
  successful Remove so you always have a forward
  path instead of a dead-end Phone Restored screen.
• Pre-flight health check retries on transient
  network blips (was a single 5s shot before).
• Welcome screen rebalanced; subtle safety stamp
  under the CTA.
• Sign-in screen adds "no password needed"
  microcopy.
• Plug-in step explains why a wired connection
  is required.

Settings → Danger Zone:
• Remove Flipped is now the primary action; Reset
  Local + Your Data collapse into "Other actions"
  for a less crowded screen.
• Removal flow copy walks you through Stolen
  Device Protection → Find My ordering (you can't
  turn Find My off without disabling SDP first).
• Removing shows a numbered timeline with time
  estimates per stage.

Email:
• Sign-in code emails are now branded with the
  Flipped wordmark and a big monospace code.

Server-side (no Mac update needed):
• Signup gap closed - randos who hit useflipped.com
  and enter their email now get an account auto-
  created instead of silent zero-email.

item.title: Version 1.0.53
item.description:
Onboarding safety net.

The "STUCK? GET HELP →" link at the bottom of every
onboarding step used to dump you straight into Mail
with a half-written support ticket.  v1.0.53 sends
you to useflipped.com/help instead — a real help
page with step-by-step recovery for every stuck
state you can hit during setup.  Self-serve first,
escalate to email only if needed.

The link also jumps you to the section that matches
where you got stuck.  Plug-in step?  Cable + trust
troubleshooting.  Enroll step?  Recovery for the
"Device Management" screen.  Smarter than a blanket
mailto:.

Plus a quiet support feature: I can now run a single
curl on my end that triggers your Mac to cleanly
remove Flipped from your iPhone.  If you ever DM me
that you're stuck, it's one command from my phone.

item.title: Version 1.0.52
item.description:
One-tap recovery + clearer picker.

Edit a preset, change your mind?  v1.0.52 adds a
"Reset to default" button when you're editing Simple
(or any preset).  One tap and you're back to the
original bundle list.  No more unchecking apps
one by one.

Also: when you toggle an Apple stock app — Maps,
Camera, Music, Calendar, etc. — to block, the picker
now warns you.  iOS supervised mode silently won't
hide those apps; the warning's just so the picker
isn't lying about what'll happen on your phone.

Quiet plumbing: if you ever get stuck and ping me,
I can now fix your local state from the backend in
one curl.  No more "uninstall + reinstall Flipped."

item.title: Version 1.0.51
item.description:
Honest unflip state.

If the network blips while you're tapping UNFLIP, the
app used to clear the "flipped" UI locally and then
silently fail to tell the server.  Result: your Mac
said free, the server still thought you were flipped,
and you couldn't recover without re-launching the app.

v1.0.51 keeps the snappy optimistic UI but reverts on
backend error and surfaces "Couldn't unflip — tap
again."  Mac state always matches server reality.

item.title: Version 1.0.50
item.description:
Menu-bar icon fix.

v1.0.49's menu-bar icon used a custom SwiftUI shape that
didn't render in the menu-bar slot.  v1.0.50 switches to
SF Symbol lock/unlock — guaranteed to show up.

  • Free       → open lock
  • Flipped    → closed lock

The rest of the menu-bar item is unchanged from 1.0.49:
status line, Flip/Unflip with your active profile, Open
Flipped, Quit Flipped.

item.title: Version 1.0.49
item.description:
Menu-bar item.

A small dash icon now lives in your menu bar, top-
right of your screen.  Click it to see your current
status, flip with your active profile, or unflip —
without opening the main Flipped window.

  • Free       → outlined dash
  • Flipped    → filled metallic-gradient dash
                 (matches the app icon)

Also surfaces:
  • Status line ("Phone is free" or "Flipped · X left")
  • Flip with [your active profile] / Unflip now
  • Open Flipped (brings the main window forward)
  • Quit Flipped

The main window keeps working exactly as before —
this is an additional surface, not a replacement.

item.title: Version 1.0.48
item.description:
Cross-client sync + reliability pass on top of 1.0.47.

Fixes a long-standing bug where the Mac app said "flipped"
even when the backend rejected the flip (most often when
your iPhone's MDM enrollment had drifted into a state
where push tokens weren't registered).  Now Mac honestly
reverts to "not flipped" and surfaces the real error so
you can act on it — instead of a UI that lies until you
manually unflip and re-flip.

Sister bug fixed: the Mac no longer ignores sessions
started elsewhere.  If you flip from useflipped.com or
another Mac, this Mac now picks it up the moment you
bring the app foreground or wake from sleep — was 15s of
"Flip" button while a session was already active.

Profile picker:
•  Deep Work and Nomad presets hidden — Simple is the
   single starter, edit or duplicate to customise.
•  Picker now only shows apps actually on your iPhone
   instead of every app you've ever classified.

Settings → Get Help additions:
•  Reset Trust button for when your Mac stops seeing
   your iPhone — no more dropping to Terminal.
•  Plain-English explainer for the "Flipped turned off
   my location services / dictation" reports we keep
   getting: Flipped never touches those toggles, the
   restriction profile only hides apps.  Re-enable
   under Settings → Privacy & Security.

Backend (deployed separately):
•  Spotify added to the always-allowed safety floor —
   flipping should no longer break background music
   playback or hide the Spotify icon unless you've
   explicitly added Spotify to your blocklist.
•  Mac now mirrors your active profile to the server
   so the website's flip button uses your real custom
   profile bundle list instead of falling back to
   Simple.

item.title: Version 1.0.47
item.description:
Setup-flow declutter pass on top of 1.0.46.

Pre-flight step (Step 3 of 6 — turn off Find My + SDP)
is materially less crowded.  The "Continue with Partial
Setup vs Erase This iPhone" warning that used to live
on pre-flight has moved down to the actual moment your
iPhone shows that screen — three places was two too
many.  WHY THIS IS SAFE trimmed to the two bullets you
can't read anywhere else in the flow.

Finalizing step (Step 5 of 6) reordered to match the
actual iOS prompt order on a real device:

    1. Tap Trust
    2. Tap Continue with Partial Setup
    3. Tap Enroll This iPhone

Done step lost the OPTIONAL · APP LIBRARY pro-tip —
the Anchor App tip stays.  Update banner clears the
macOS traffic-light cluster now (used to live behind
the close/minimize/zoom buttons because the window has
a hidden title bar).

item.title: Version 1.0.46
item.description:
Big architectural upgrade + a lot of setup polish.

Under the hood: supervision now uses native Swift +
Apple's MobileDevice.framework directly (the same one
Apple Configurator uses) instead of a bundled Python
script.  Faster, cleaner, fewer moving parts.  Same
flip / unflip experience.

The legacy Python path stays as a runtime escape hatch
in case anyone hits a bug on the new path:

    defaults write com.flippedapp.Flipped \
      FlippedUseLegacySupervise -bool YES

Setup-flow polish (top of the list):
•  Setup screens no longer flash past — Step 4 (Setting
   Up) and Step 5 (Finalizing) now have manual NEXT
   buttons so you control the pace.
•  Trust state on Step 2 detected near-instantly (was
   waiting up to 30s).  Uses the same usbmuxd state
   Finder uses, so if Finder sees your iPhone, Flipped
   sees it.
•  Pre-flight "WHY THIS IS SAFE" + "HEADS UP" cards
   tightened up — fits cleanly without scrolling.
•  Settings → Remove failure copy leads with the real
   most-common cause (Mac trust state) instead of
   burying it under Find My.
•  Email field text appears immediately on paste —
   was invisible on macOS Light Mode until a keystroke.
•  Backend cleans up MDMEnrollment row when you remove
   the supervision from your iPhone, so re-setup
   doesn't see "already enrolled" from stale data.

Internal: 200KB Swift kit replaces 50MB of bundled
libimobiledevice + a 13MB bundled Python.  The full
size reduction lands in v1.0.47+ once the legacy
path retires.

item.title: Version 1.0.45
item.description:
Three setup-friction fixes before launch.

1.  Get unstuck without emailing support.  If setup fails
    OR the FINALIZING step hangs for 2+ minutes waiting on
    iPhone enrollment, a compact "Problem?  Remove Flipped
    while we get you support so you can keep using your
    phone." card appears with a single REMOVE button.
    Rolls back the supervision profile cleanly — no factory
    reset, no terminal.

2.  Pre-flight step now explains WHY Flipped needs Find
    My and Stolen Device Protection off — and exactly
    what Flipped can and can't see on your iPhone (it
    cannot read messages, photos, location, or your
    Apple ID).  Clear bullets, not a wall of legalese.

3.  Stolen Device Protection 1-hour delay now reminds
    users to set a phone alarm and confirm the toggle
    within a minute of expiry — iOS resets the timer
    otherwise, costing another hour.

item.title: Version 1.0.44
item.description:
One-click "Reset Trust" when iPhone gets stuck.

When setup hangs on "Waiting for iPhone" because your
Mac is holding a stale USB pair record, a Reset Trust
button now appears in the diagnostic.  Tap it, enter
your Mac password once, Flipped wipes the stale record
and bounces usbmuxd in the background — no Terminal,
no sudo, just unplug and re-plug afterward.

Plus: bundled Python 3.12 (~13 MB, signed) means the
"Install Command Line Developer Tools" dialog never
appears on fresh Macs.  Setup ships with everything it
needs.

item.title: Version 1.0.43
item.description:
Clearer setup heads-up about Stolen Device Protection.

Pre-flight step now spells out that iOS 17.3+ adds a
1-hour Security Delay when disabling Stolen Device
Protection or Find My away from a "Significant Location"
(Home / Work).  At home the toggle is immediate; in a
coffee shop or hotel users may have to wait.  Doing
setup at home is the recommended path.

item.title: Version 1.0.42
item.description:
Real fix for locked-phone flips.

When you tap FLIP with your iPhone locked, iOS replies
"NotNow" to the install command — meaning "I got it but
can't process while locked, hold this."  Pre-1.0.42 the
server treated NotNow as a full Ack and dropped the
command from the queue.  After unlock, the iPhone had
nothing to apply.

Now the server keeps the command pending through NotNow
replies, so the moment you unlock, the iPhone polls the
queue, finds the InstallProfile still waiting, and
applies it.  Flips that fail at lock time now succeed
the instant you unlock.

Also: the orange "WAITING FOR IPHONE…" badge no longer
flashes during normal flips — only appears after 7
seconds of actually waiting.

item.title: Version 1.0.41
item.description:
"WAITING FOR IPHONE…" now clears within seconds.

The Mac was re-checking session state every 30 seconds, so
even after the backend self-healed an orphaned flip, the UI
sat on "WAITING FOR IPHONE…" for up to half a minute.  Now
it re-checks every 5 seconds while waiting, and fires one
immediate check the moment you tap FLIP — so the badge
disappears within ~5s of the iPhone applying the profile.

item.title: Version 1.0.40
item.description:
Fix the "update again" loop.

Pre-1.0.40, every release shipped with CFBundleVersion=1
because build-dmg.sh only set the marketing version, not
the build number.  Sparkle compares CFBundleVersion to
sparkle:version in the appcast — so "1" was always less
than "1.0.39", and the update banner re-appeared on every
launch even right after you updated.

This release sets both version fields at build time so the
installed app's build number actually matches what's in
the appcast.  After installing 1.0.40, the banner stays
hidden until a real 1.0.41 ships.

item.title: Version 1.0.39
item.description:
Two quiet fixes.

1. No more "Couldn't sync apps: Server error 404" banner.
   The Mac was calling a backend endpoint that didn't
   exist yet; the actual app-list refresh always worked,
   the error was just noise.  Endpoint is now wired up,
   so the sync triggers a real refresh from your iPhone.

2. Update banner appears automatically.  Flipped now
   checks for updates in the background on launch and
   every hour after — you'll see the "Update available"
   banner without having to open the menu.

item.title: Version 1.0.38
item.description:
Edit a preset profile in place — no more "X Custom" duplicate.

Before: tapping the pencil on Simple spawned a separate
"Simple Custom" row in the Profiles list.  Edits to either
diverged and the list got cluttered.

Now: edits modify the preset in place, and any leftover
"X Custom" rows from before are removed on launch.

Plus everything from 1.0.37 — flips retry every 30s while
your iPhone is locked / offline, and Home shows "WAITING
FOR IPHONE · UNLOCK TO APPLY" until iOS confirms.

item.title: Version 1.0.37
item.description:
Flips now retry until your iPhone is reachable.

If your iPhone is locked or offline when you tap FLIP, the
server keeps re-pushing every 30 seconds for up to 10 minutes
— so the next time the phone unlocks, the flip lands without
you having to do anything.

Home shows "WAITING FOR IPHONE · UNLOCK TO APPLY" while we're
still waiting, and switches to "PHONE IS FLIPPED" the moment
iOS confirms.

item.title: Version 1.0.36
item.description:
redesign: Time Regained becomes a 4-cell stopwatch grid

The single chrome value flanked by em-dashes (1.0.35) is replaced
by a four-cell grid: DAYS · HRS · MIN · SEC, each on a subtle
white fill, numbers in the FLIPPED chrome silver gradient.

While you're flipped, the seconds tick live every second.  All
four units stay visible at every scale — no auto-hiding of zero
days or zero hours.
